notes: Data-loss fix: web order-edit adding a new item no longer deletes untouched lines. orders.service.updateOrderItems now picks `replaceAll = dto.replaceAll ?? allNewItems` (UpdateOrderItemsDto gained `replaceAll?`); web useUpdateOrderItems/handleSaveItems send `replaceAll:false` (incremental merge → id-less items appended); mobile omits the flag → legacy replace-all heuristic preserved. findOne + updateOrderItems return now `orderBy lineItems createdAt asc` so new items render at the bottom. Earlier batch: (1) Customer email now OPTIONAL — create-customer.dto `@IsOptional`, customers.service.create mints `no-email+<uuid>@placeholder.local` for the required+unique User.email and leaves Customer.email null; sendPortalInvite + web CustomerFormModal ignore the placeholder; web username derived from name when email absent. Spec customers.service.spec.ts. (2) Price carry-forward to future orders extended to the EDIT screens (web EditableLineItems + mobile edit-items pre-fill remembered price via useCustomerPriceHistory; create screens already did). (3) Auto-scroll the just-scanned line into view: web CreateOrderModal, web invoices/new, web orders/[id] EditableLineItems (ref-map + scrollIntoView); mobile NewOrderScreen + invoices/new (ScrollView ref + per-row onLayout offset map). Prior batch: per-line price+discount editing on DRAFT orders (web+mobile); discount double-count fix + customer price memory (#101).
